title: Expensive Specialized Crevice Tool
text:
Expensive Specialized Crevice Tool. This BLACK & DECKER HHVJ320BMF26 SMARTECH CORDLESS 2.0Ah LITHIUM HAND VACUUM is a terrific crevice tool, but the price (about $122 on Amazon) blows me away. There are features that I love--the lighted display that shows how much charge is left; the built-in crevice tool extension--but the usefulness of this "hand vacuum" is severely limited by the 2-inch-wide nozzle. The battery holds enough charge to vacuum a flight of carpeted stairs on the high-speed "power boost" setting (impressive!), but it takes a zillion passes to do stairs in 2-inch-wide strips.

The suction is okay on the low-speed setting, and very good on the high-speed setting. It takes 5 hours for a full charge, so you'll probably want to store it in the plugged-in charger (wall-mounting hardware is included) to keep it topped off, as the manual recommends. The charger light turns off when charging is complete, but removing the device from the charger for even a few moments will cause the charger to restart for a few minutes.

The crevice tool extension makes this ideal for cleaning my stairway, which has a stair lift installed. (The support posts for the stair-lift track not only collect dust, but are hard to clean around.) However, the release button for the extension is stiff, so that it's often difficult to push the extension back into the nozzle for storage. The crevice tool extension is great for cleaning crevices in overstuffed furniture. The nozzle without the extension does a good job of dusting a smooth rubber floor mat.

The hand vacuum is fairly easy to clean. The big cyclonic element in the handle releases easily, and the whole thing pulls out sideways. Dust, dirt, and larger particles collect around the plastic filter module, and are easily dumped into a trash container. However, thick dust accumulates quickly on the cloth filter inside the plastic filter--and it clings, so the "dust bunnies" must be pulled off by hand. (This isn't good if you have allergies or asthma.) Filter reassembly is simple, and the filters are washable.

This is a vacuum for dry materials only. After washing, the filters need to be completely dry before you operate the vacuum. The cyclonic element is not particularly capacious, so I can't see this device as indispensable for ordinary kitchen cleanups like cereal, flour, or dry pet food spills. It is lightweight, and well-balanced for hand vacuuming.

As good as this device is for cleaning crevices in upholstered furniture and for cleaning carpeted steps, it is expensive for such a specialized tool. Also, it requires storage space and an electrical outlet to keep it charged and always available for ready use. For these reasons, I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

description: The BLACK+DECKER cordless lithium ion hand vacuum has strong suction to pick up dirt and debris from big to small messes. Lightweight and cordless portability makes cleaning convenient for tough to reach areas and cars too. A pull-out crevice tool helps you clean hard-to-reach areas and the flip-up brush is ideal for dusting and cleaning upholstery. Translucent, washable dirt bowl and filters are easy to clean between jobs. And SMARTECHTM sensing technology alerts you how much battery remains and when it’s time to clean the filter. Includes: wall-mountable charging base, flip-up brush, extendable crevice tool, Vbf10 washable bag filter, washable plastic Pre-Filter.
